title: Renewal Offer Plan Credit by Billing Plan, Named Non-Owner Policy
content:
The renewal offer premium of a Named Non-Owner Policy term carries a credit set by the billing plan of the expiring term.

| Billing plan of the expiring term (Installment Payment Plans) | Plan credit |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | 0.94 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | 0.97 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 0.97 |
| Two-Pay, Four-Pay, Six-Pay Direct Bill or any other plan | none |

The credit multiplies the renewal offer premium before that figure is rounded to the cent; every other plan carries no such credit.
